# MYSMME

> MYSMME is an online saree marketplace in India focused on helping customers discover and shop sarees across different fabrics, styles, occasions and price ranges.

Website: https://mysmme.com
API: https://api.mysmme.com

## Main Sections

- Home: https://mysmme.com
- Sarees: https://mysmme.com/sarees
- New Arrivals: https://mysmme.com/new-arrivals
- Sarees Under ₹999: https://mysmme.com/under-999
- Premium Sarees: https://mysmme.com/premium-sarees
- Wedding Collection: https://mysmme.com/wedding-collection
- Daily Wear Sarees: https://mysmme.com/daily-wear
- Deals: https://mysmme.com/deals
- Contact: https://mysmme.com/contact

## Product Categories

MYSMME features sarees including:

- Silk Sarees
- Banarasi Silk Sarees
- Cotton Sarees
- Linen Sarees
- Georgette Sarees
- Chiffon Sarees
- Organza Sarees
- Designer Sarees
- Party Wear Sarees
- Wedding Sarees
- Daily Wear Sarees
- Office Wear Sarees

## About MYSMME

MYSMME is a saree-focused online marketplace serving customers in India.

Customers can discover sarees based on fabric, colour, category, occasion, brand and price.

The marketplace includes affordable sarees as well as premium collections from different sellers and brands.
